proposed_rules.trigger: On a download/template page, a full-width template preview image ([2x1]/[3x1]/[4x1]/[3x2]) is followed, across one or several sibling nodes with intervening empty spacers, by an 'Install the Free Template App' button.
proposed_rules.decision: Model the preview image and the install CTA as ONE composite block (image cell + CTA cell) regardless of how many empty spacer nodes separate them in the raw tree; do not emit each spacer as its own section.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: (a) split into a generic image block and a separate CTA link, obscuring that the image and button perform one paired action; (b) treat each empty spacer sibling (rc1c2c4, rc1c2c6) as a distinct section, rejected because they carry no content and are layout-only gaps.

provenance.evidence: C82 rc1c2c3 [4x1] preview, rc1c2c4/rc1c2c6 empty spacers, rc1c2c5 'Install the Free Template App'

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width '[2x1] Get Started with Knack's ___' banner naming the specific template/app, positioned directly before the footer on template/download pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as a reusable CTA banner block parametrized by template name, not page-unique free text.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structural position, size class, and wording pattern recur across all sampled download-template pages, indicating a shared component rather than one-off copy.
